claim: A two-zone (thin disc plus diffusive halo of half-height L) diffusion model fitted to B/C leaves the diffusion normalization K0 and L strongly correlated, with K0/L the combination the ratio determines.

scope.text: two-zone and 1D diffusion models, with or without convection and reacceleration

claim: The weighted-slab technique (a path-length distribution applied to the slab solution) reproduces the diffusion-model result for stable nuclei under conditions on energy changes and spatial structure; its modified form and its limits are discussed against diffusion models.
limitations: unverified: attributed from background knowledge; this profile derives its own exact equivalence for the thin-disc pure-diffusion case (derivation record) and does not rely on the paper's conditions

limitations: unverified: attributed from background knowledge; the profile's form lambda_esc = n_H m_H h v L / D is derived and checked here (derive.py), not quoted
